name: Payback
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to trust the Lord to fight their battles rather than seeking personal payback, as seen in Exodus 14:14. Christ commands His followers to love their enemies and do good to those who hate them, rejecting retaliation (Luke 6:27). Romans 12:17 reinforces this by instructing Christians not to repay evil for evil but to live honorably. Ultimately, God's love and justice prevail, demonstrated supremely in the giving of His Son (John 3:16) and the coming revelation of Christ's judgment (Revelation 1:1; James 5:1).
